events.message: Pushed a commit: "TEST DATA — fix nav bug on mobile Safari"
events.extra:
Root cause was a stale event listener that never got cleaned up on unmount.

Also removed some now-unused CSS classes while I was in there.

events.message: Merged PR #1: "TEST DATA — add Story Mode transitions"
events.extra:
This adds the full Story Mode feature end to end.

Includes tide-wipe SVG transitions, ambient bubble animation, and a nested Milestone Reel.

Initial test release.

- Added multi-tank support
- Added dependency-aware build checklist
- Fixed a handful of sorting bugs

events.message: Opened issue #1: "TEST DATA — cart quantity cap not enforced"
events.extra: Quantity selector allows values above the configured max cap on mobile Safari specifically — likely a debounce timing issue.

events.message: Pushed 5 commits — latest: "TEST DATA — widget iframe localStorage fix"
events.extra: Widget was reading localStorage via the page's global binding instead of the StorageAccessHandle, which broke inside the embedded iframe context.
